title: DestructionAuthorization
description: PACK-09, ADR-039. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.domain.DestructionAuthorization). The separate, explicit authorization step between 'eligible' and 'destroyed' - governed records are never removed by an ordinary delete (PACK-09 required invariant 4). Bound to the exact retention_policy_version and authorized_record_version it was issued against, so a later policy supersession or record change makes it stale (DESTRUCTION_AUTHORIZATION_STALE) instead of silently remaining usable (PACK-09 required invariant 5). No field here carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a document or its bytes, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13). Natural persons appear only as per-case party references minted by epd2_compliance_service.domain.mint_case_party_reference, which resolve to nothing inside or outside this service.
